review.purpose: Discover required fields and the actual worker-local template path, then use them to render a real summary.
review.finding: One bundled sample_invoice template declares customer/total. The discovered path drives a materialized render of Acorn Studio with the SQL-calculated net amount. Returned XML includes the expected customer/net and no unresolved tags. Its two fields explain why the six-field companion is needed for the complete discount breakdown.

review.purpose: Render exact SQL-formatted values into one document per customer and check content beyond a BLOB header.
review.finding: Five returned customer documents contain exactly eight expected paragraphs each, including rounded gross/discount/net strings. The10→15percent experiment changes net amounts but preserves source gross and document counts. Malformed template bytes produce NULL; subsequent valid rendering succeeds. No PDF mode or office layout fidelity is claimed.

review.purpose: Reconcile whole-relation merging against the exact multiset of customer blocks before comparing package size.
review.finding: The merged BLOB contains every verified customer summary exactly once.
